Course Templates
================

.. role:: sql(code)
    :language: sql

Course templates are a collection of abstract sql queries. These are used to create the courses. In the first step
based on the abstract queries concrete queries are generated by AI for the specific database. In the second step these
queries are used as sample solutions to generate the exercises.

For example the course template contains :sql:`SELECT * FROM [table1];`. This generates something like
:sql:`SELECT * FROM books;` for a library database. Then in the final step the task *"Select every column
from the table 'books'"* is generated.

The structure of the course templates is based on :class:`BaseModels.CourseTemplate`.
